boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Emerson rituals that turn oratory, student productions, recognition, orientation, comedy, and even nonexistent football into shared college lore.

cards.title: Take the Stage for Emerson’s Oldest Tradition
cards.subtitle: A recital lineage stretching back to 1900
cards.notes: Watch alumni and faculty carry Emerson’s oratory roots forward through live interpretation; consult Alumni Weekend programming before attending.
cards.short_summary: Emerson’s longest-running tradition keeps expressive speech onstage.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson marked the Southwick Recital’s 125th anniversary in 2025 and identifies it as the College’s longest-running tradition, begun in 1900.
cards.source_title: Emerson is Celebrating 125 Years of Southwick Recitals on Friday
cards.access_notes: Presented through scheduled College programming; verify the current recital date, venue, and admission conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Produce a Student Awards Broadcast During Finals
cards.subtitle: Emerson’s live show has grown from eight categories to 68
cards.notes: Follow the annual production through its official program, then notice how students fill both the creative categories and technical crew.
cards.short_summary: A student-built broadcast recognizes work from across Emerson.
cards.evidence_claim: The EVVYs began in 1982, reached its 45th year in 2026, and expanded from eight television categories to 68 categories across Emerson disciplines.
cards.source_title: The Best of Emerson: 45 Years of The EVVYs
cards.access_notes: Participation and audience arrangements vary by year; consult the current EVVYs announcement or official production channels.

cards.title: Applaud the People Who Build Campus Life
cards.subtitle: The ERA Awards recognize Emerson community contributions
cards.notes: Look for the annual nominee and recipient announcements to see which student leaders and community builders Emerson is celebrating.
cards.short_summary: An annual ceremony turns campus service into a public celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson held its annual Emerson Recognition and Achievement Awards on April 18, 2025, presenting the Spirit of Emerson and Kindness awards.
cards.source_title: Fuccillo ’24 and Murphy ’26 Embody Kindness and Spirit of Emerson’s Annual Awards
cards.access_notes: The awards serve the Emerson community; nomination, invitation, and audience rules should be checked for the current cycle.

cards.title: Turn the Whole Campus Into hALLoween
cards.subtitle: A College-wide festival whose name puts the “all” on display
cards.notes: Check the published festival calendar and choose an age-inclusive event such as pumpkin painting, trivia, student performance, or film.
cards.short_summary: Nine days of student-led programming give Halloween an Emerson spelling.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson’s official hALLoween page documents a nine-day campus festival with free student-led performances, immersive events, and festive activities.
cards.access_notes: Dates, locations, capacity, and RSVP requirements differ by event; use the current official festival schedule.

cards.title: Eat the Movie One Scene at a Time
cards.subtitle: Screen moments arrive with corresponding bites
cards.notes: Reserve through the current campus listing, disclose dietary needs, and experience how Emerson Mane Events translates a film into food.
cards.short_summary: A screening becomes an edible, synchronized production.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson identifies Movie Taste Experiences among its iconic campus traditions and documented a Nightmare Before Christmas edition pairing scenes with curated food and drink.
cards.access_notes: The featured film, venue, RSVP rules, capacity, and allergen accommodations vary; consult the current Emerson event listing.

cards.title: Start the Semester With Weeks, Not a Day
cards.subtitle: Emerson Mane Events’ extended welcome tradition
cards.notes: Open the current EmConnect schedule, choose activities suited to your interests, and use the series to meet student organizations early.
cards.short_summary: Emerson stretches its beginning-of-term welcome across multiple events.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson’s Student Engagement and Leadership portal identifies Weeks of Welcome as one of the iconic traditions hosted by Emerson Mane Events.
cards.access_notes: Programming is intended for the Emerson community and changes by term; sign in to EmConnect for current eligibility and RSVP details.

cards.title: Browse Decades of Student-Made Emerson
cards.subtitle: The fall fair introduces more than 100 organizations
cards.notes: Scan the organization list beforehand, then speak with several groups at the fall fair instead of committing at the first table.
cards.short_summary: A long-running fall gathering maps Emerson through its student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson states that students have attended its Student Organization Fair at the start of the fall semester for decades to explore more than 100 organizations.
cards.source_title: A Community of Independent Minds & Daring Ideas
cards.access_notes: The fair is a campus involvement event; verify the current date, venue, and Emerson-community access requirements.

cards.title: Arrive to a Bullhorn Welcome on Tremont Street
cards.subtitle: Orientation leaders cheer new Lions into downtown Boston
cards.notes: New students should follow their assigned arrival window and listen for orientation leaders directing the welcome and move-in flow.
cards.short_summary: Move-in becomes a street-level welcome performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson’s 2025 account calls Move-In Day a tradition and documents orientation leaders greeting arriving students with cheers and bullhorns on Tremont Street.
cards.source_title: Emerson Welcomes a New Pride of Lions on Move-In Day
cards.access_notes: This welcome is tied to assigned student move-in operations; follow Housing and Residential Education instructions rather than visiting independently.

cards.title: Let Student Comics Compete Live at ComEx!
cards.subtitle: An annual Emerson festival hosts “The Jess” finalists
cards.notes: Check the Center for Comedic Arts calendar for the festival program; competition eligibility is limited even when an audience is admitted.
cards.short_summary: Emerson’s comedy training culminates in a live spring festival.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson’s Center for Comedic Arts documents ComEx! as an annual spring comedy festival and scheduled 2026 finalists for the Jess Ilias Clavelli Comedy Award to perform live there.
cards.access_notes: The Jess competition is limited to eligible Emerson juniors and seniors; verify separate audience access for the current ComEx! festival.

cards.title: Celebrate a Football Team That Never Takes the Field
cards.subtitle: The joke survives on alumni-kept T-shirts
cards.notes: Treat the shirt as Emerson wordplay, not an athletics claim: the official alumni story explicitly frames the nonexistent team as campus lore.
cards.short_summary: No football program means the fictional team can never lose.
cards.evidence_claim: An official Emerson alumni story documents the recurring joke that the College’s football team has never been defeated and notes alumni retaining shirts that celebrate it.
cards.source_title: EVVY Programs and Quidditch Capes: Things We Kept From Our Emerson Days
cards.access_notes: This is documented alumni lore rather than a scheduled event; no team activity or public access is implied.
